VendingMachine.__init__:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Initializes the object state by setting inventory to an empty dictionary and balance to zero." __init__]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Set the instance attribute inventory to an empty dictionary. RESULT self.inventory]
            [COMMAND Set the instance attribute balance to the integer 0. RESULT self.balance]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
VendingMachine.add_item:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Adds or updates an inventory item with the given price and quantity when the restock_item call returns a falsy value." add_item]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> item_name </REF>: string "Name or key of the inventory item to add or update."
        <REF> price </REF>: number "Price to store in the inventory entry."
        <REF> quantity </REF>: number "Quantity passed to restock_item and stored in the inventory entry if restock_item returns a falsy value."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Call self.restock_item(item_name, quantity) and capture the return value. RESULT restock_result]
            [COMMAND Evaluate `not restock_result` by inverting the truthiness of restock_result; set restock_failed to True when restock_result is falsy (False, None, 0, or an empty container), otherwise set restock_failed to False. RESULT restock_failed]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: restock_failed is True, meaning the return value of self.restock_item(item_name, quantity) was falsy and `not self.restock_item(item_name, quantity)` is True.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Set self.inventory[item_name] to {'price': price, 'quantity': quantity}. RESULT inventory_entry]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
VendingMachine.insert_coin:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Adds the provided amount to the instance balance and returns the updated balance." insert_coin]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> amount </REF>: number "The amount to add to the current balance."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> updated_balance </REF>: number "The updated value of self.balance after adding amount."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Add the current self.balance and amount, then assign the result back to self.balance. RESULT updated_balance]
            [COMMAND Return the updated self.balance value. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
VendingMachine.purchase_item:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Attempts to purchase an item by name if it exists in inventory, has positive stock, and the buyer has enough balance; on success it deducts the price, decrements stock, and returns the updated balance, otherwise it returns False." purchase_item]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> item_name </REF>: string "Name of the item to purchase"
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> purchase_result </REF>: number or boolean "Updated balance when the purchase succeeds; False when the item does not exist, stock is zero, or balance is insufficient"
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Check whether item_name exists as a key in self.inventory. RESULT item_exists]
            [COMMAND Within the outer true branch where item_exists is true, retrieve the item record from self.inventory using item_name. RESULT item]
            [COMMAND Within the same outer true branch, check whether item['quantity'] is greater than 0; only if true, check whether self.balance is greater than or equal to item['price']. RESULT purchase_allowed]
            [COMMAND Within the inner true branch where purchase_allowed is true, subtract item['price'] from self.balance and store the result back into self.balance. RESULT updated_balance]
            [COMMAND Within the same inner true branch, decrement item['quantity'] by 1. RESULT updated_quantity]
            [COMMAND Return the updated_balance value as the method result. RESULT purchase_result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: item_name is not a key in self.inventory.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return False from the outer false branch. RESULT purchase_result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: item_name exists in self.inventory and either item['quantity'] is less than or equal to 0, or item['quantity'] is greater than 0 but self.balance is less than item['price'].]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return False from the inner false branch. RESULT purchase_result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
VendingMachine.restock_item:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Adds the specified quantity to an existing inventory item's quantity and returns True if the item exists, otherwise returns False." restock_item]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> item_name </REF>: string "Key of the inventory item to restock."
        <REF> quantity </REF>: number "Amount to add to the inventory item's current quantity."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: boolean "True if the inventory item exists and was updated, False otherwise."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Check whether item_name exists as a key in self.inventory. RESULT item_exists]
            [COMMAND Within the if branch where item_exists is true, add quantity to self.inventory[item_name]['quantity']. RESULT updated_quantity]
            [COMMAND Within the same if branch, return True. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: If item_name is not in self.inventory.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return False. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
VendingMachine.display_items:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Display inventory items and their prices and quantities, returning False when inventory is falsy and a newline-separated formatted string otherwise." display_items]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> formatted_result </REF>: bool|string "Returns the boolean False when self.inventory is falsy; otherwise returns a newline-separated string of formatted inventory items."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Evaluate the condition `not self.inventory` to check whether self.inventory is falsy. RESULT inventory_is_falsy]
            [COMMAND If inventory_is_falsy is true, immediately return the boolean False and terminate without processing items. RESULT early_return]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: self.inventory is truthy and contains at least one item.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Within the else branch, initialize an empty list named items. RESULT items]
            [COMMAND For each item_name and item_info pair from self.inventory.items(), append the exact formatted string "{item_name} - ${item_info['price']} [{item_info['quantity']}]" to the items list. RESULT items]
            [COMMAND After the loop completes, join the items list into a single string using newline characters as separators and return that string. RESULT formatted_result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
